name: 95336 · Manteca, CA
findings: ZIP 95336 (Manteca) has 93 nonprofit organizations. 40 of them (43%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 29 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (48% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 95336 (Manteca) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 95336 (Manteca) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 74% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 39 organizations here; 33% of all organizations here have no identified type.
